quest.title: Animal Research: Capybaras
quest.description: According to intel from The Flagship, a group of smugglers has been poaching rare-colored Capybaras in Natlan...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Unknown Item #369228 x1

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After some time...

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Alhoma
dialogues.text: I warned you more than once — keep your eyes open. This is premium stock, personally requested by repeat clients in Snezhnograd.

dialogues.speaker: Alhoma
dialogues.text: And you just let it go? Have you gone soft on me? Did you suddenly grow a conscience or what?

dialogues.speaker: Yelo
dialogues.text: Boss, listen, it's really not my fault. Those Hilichurls—

dialogues.speaker: Alhoma
dialogues.text: Hilichurls? You're using that as an excuse? Keep this up and you'll make a joke of our Treasure Hoarder brand!

dialogues.speaker: Yelo
dialogues.text: I couldn't handle them, boss. I really couldn't! The blue one and its green friend hit harder than those Agents...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (These two... they're definitely smugglers.)

dialogues.speaker: Alhoma
dialogues.text: ...Who's there?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Easy, Lumi! Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Alhoma
dialogues.text: What's this? Hmm... A rare find.

dialogues.speaker: Alhoma
dialogues.text: Hey, you can handle a little girl, yeah? This looks solid enough. Let's swap it in and call it a day.

dialogues.speaker: Yelo
dialogues.text: Yes, boss.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: You have the nerve to go after Lumi now? You're the reason the Treasure Hoarders' reputation is in the gutter...

dialogues.speaker: Yelo
dialogues.text: "Reputation"? The Treasure Hoarders have a... what now?

dialogues.speaker: Alhoma
dialogues.text: Stop wasting your breath on her!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: They fled in a panic... Tsk, pathetic.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (The smuggled Capybara isn't here... Could this have something to do with the Hilichurls?)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Let's see if we can find any clues nearby.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It really is a silver Capybara... No dye, no trick of the light. This is so incredibly rare... absolutely astonishing!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I searched all over Natlan and never managed to find one. Turns out, it got snatched by smugglers.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: But it doesn't seem hurt... Hehe, a silver Capybara! Never imagined I'd get to see one with my own eyes! Let me just— oh, let me feel it for a moment, see if this silver one feels any different from the ordinary ones...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Ouch! It's burning hot!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Ah, I almost forgot! You're still in the pot!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Could it be that you've grown used to Natlan's liquid Phlogiston, so this temperature barely fazes you?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Anyway, you're coming back with me for now!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: You should count yourselves lucky it was me you ran into, and not Grandma Hiljetta!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Wow, so the silver Capybara really exists... Wait, why's it in a pot!?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Heh, I'd better let Mikko and the others see this little wonder before sending it back!
